blogs.title: From LoRA to OFT to BOFT: A Visual Guide to Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
blogs.description: Explain the evolution of PEFT methods—additive low-rank (LoRA), orthogonal finetuning (OFT), and butterfly orthogonal finetuning (BOFT). Use visual intuition to show how each reparameterizes weights, the training/inference trade-offs, when each shines, and how BOFT achieves dense transforms with far fewer parameters.

blogs.title: Butterfly Networks 101: FFT-Inspired Structures for Smarter Fine-Tuning
blogs.description: Introduce butterfly structures through the fast Fourier transform and show how they translate into sparse factorization that builds dense orthogonal matrices. Walk through the information transmission view, why O(d log d) parameters are possible, and how this improves expressivity vs block-diagonal OFT.

blogs.title: Hands-on Tutorial: Implementing BOFT in PyTorch for LLMs and ViTs
blogs.description: A practical, end-to-end guide to building BOFT modules: Cayley parameterization for 2x2 blocks, stacking butterfly components, identity initialization, and integrating into transformer layers. Include training tips, common pitfalls, and how to fold BOFT weights back for zero inference overhead.

blogs.title: Tuning BOFT: How to Choose m and b Under a Parameter Budget
blogs.description: Demystify BOFT hyperparameters. Provide heuristics for selecting the depth (m) and block size (b), discuss trade-offs among parameter count, expressivity, and runtime, and offer recipes for small vs large models and tasks. Include guidance on layer selection and scheduling strategies.

blogs.title: Multiplicative Dropout: Regularizing Orthogonal Adapters Without Breaking Them
blogs.description: Explain why standard dropout mismatches multiplicative updates and present BOFT’s multiplicative dropout. Show how to sample components/blocks to identity, when to apply it, and empirical effects on overfitting and stability for language and vision tasks.

blogs.title: Why Orthogonal Fine-Tuning Stabilizes Training: A Spectral Perspective
blogs.description: Break down how orthogonal updates preserve the spectral norm of pretrained weights and why that helps optimization and generalization. Compare with low-rank additive updates, show SVD-based reasoning, and discuss implications for longer training runs and lower learning rates.

blogs.title: Dense vs Sparse: Rethinking Adapter Expressivity with Butterfly Factorization
blogs.description: Use the information transmission framework to compare block-diagonal and butterfly sparsity. Discuss how BOFT approximates dense orthogonal transforms, recovers classic linear transforms, and balances inductive bias and flexibility to reduce overfitting.

blogs.title: BOFT in the Wild: Benchmarks Across Vision, Language, and Diffusion Models
blogs.description: Summarize cross-domain results from ViTs, LLMs, and text-to-image diffusion. Highlight parameter savings, accuracy vs runtime, and practical takeaways for practitioners choosing a PEFT method under compute constraints.

blogs.title: Build Better Adaptation Stacks: Combining BOFT with Quantization and LoRA
blogs.description: Explore hybrid recipes: BOFT with 4-bit quantization (QLoRA-style pipelines), pairing BOFT on attention with LoRA on MLPs, or staged unfreezing. Discuss memory/latency budgets, deployment implications, and when hybrids outperform single-method baselines.

blogs.title: Beyond Transformers: Can BOFT Help Graphs, RNNs, and Time-Series?
blogs.description: Speculate and prototype BOFT for non-transformer architectures. Discuss how orthogonal butterfly updates interact with recurrence, graph message passing, and long-context time-series layers, outlining small experiments and expected benefits.
